# Contributing to tuple

Thanks for your interest in contributing to tuple! We welcome fixes, documentation improvements and new features.

How to contribute

1. Fork the repository (if you don't have push access).
2. Create a branch for your change: `git checkout -b feat/my-change`.
3. Make small, focused commits with descriptive messages.
4. Open a pull request describing the change and why it is needed.

Guidelines

- Keep changes focused and small.
- Add or update documentation when behavior changes.
- Run any relevant tests (if available) and ensure your changes do not break existing features.

Communication

If your feature is large or you want feedback before implementing, open an issue first to discuss the design.
